_doc: Editorial lexicon — Sequoia/a16z-style thesis terms for NFRI. Quadrant taglines render on charts and legends; thesis_lexicon informs essay and chart copy. Consumed by harness/build_essays.py, harness/frontend/client.py, contract/scatter_methodology.json.

earning_it.label: Earning it
earning_it.one_liner: Exposed and prepared enough to match — the quadrant the market should reward.

whitespace.label: Whitespace
whitespace.one_liner: Preparedness ahead of exposure — rated paper waiting on the autopilot window.

sidelined.label: Sidelined
sidelined.one_liner: Neither materially exposed nor yet prepared — the bench the damage read never notices.

exposed.label: Exposed
exposed.one_liner: Passes a hazard or line-card read — misses availability posture until curtailment bites.

damage_first_pass.gloss: A one-axis or hazard-first review clears the name; availability posture does not.

judgement_surplus.gloss: Balance-sheet and product depth the market has not yet routed onto non-firm risk.

autopilot_window.gloss: Interval before queue repricing closes where register-native cover can still deploy.

register_native.gloss: Cover that reads Gate, ECR and connection terms off public registers — not broker guesswork.

trigger_gap.gloss: Schedule still waits on physical damage while the operator log shows lawful curtailment.

placement_surface.gloss: Brokers and carriers pricing posture above the register — intelligence-heavy, fragmented.

claims_mirror.gloss: The same policy failure seen from the adjuster workflow — exposure visible before notification.

queue_physics.gloss: Triple-digit gigawatts waiting; the connections clearing fastest are non-firm by contract.

construct_stability.gloss: Ordering inside quadrants moves as registers land; two axes and one margin do not.

provisional_gate.gloss: Measured share below publication threshold — magnitudes directional, shape is the claim.

chart_titles.quadrant_distribution: The damage read clears most names. Availability reads the rest.
chart_titles.quadrant_distribution_sub: One plane, four fates — median cuts at exposure {{cut_exp}} · preparedness {{cut_prep}}.
